note: No queryable zoning district polygon layer found for Yazoo County (FIPS 28163). Yazoo County's ArcGIS parcel service (YAZOO_Service_v104) has no zoning field; CMPDD's county and Yazoo City map services (gis3/gis.cmpdd.org) were unreachable and list no zoning layer.
